summary: Public projects created on 16 October 2026: 7 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: Agent tooling covers a per-turn context router, ChatGPT plugins, and skills for Israeli research and right-to-left work. Text classifiers sort voice-note transcripts into tasks and separate genuine stranger email from pseudo-personalised outreach. A dictation cleanup model and its evaluation dataset are planned.

projects.name: Agent Context Harness
projects.description: Per-turn router that sends each agent message to the current task, an existing parallel worker, or a new parallel session - context hygiene without compaction. Idea + prior-art scan.

projects.name: ASR Post Processor Model
projects.description: Light-touch text-in/text-out model that cleans raw Parakeet v2 dictation: disfluencies, contractions, paragraphs. Planning stage.

projects.name: ChatGPT Plugins
projects.description: Daniel Rosehill's public plugins for ChatGPT (adapted from his Claude Code marketplace) as an importable plugin marketplace catalogue

projects.name: Israel Research Skills
projects.description: Israel-specific research skills for Claude and ChatGPT: Kol Zchut rights, Home Front Command guidelines, NSC travel warnings, medicines, offices, phone numbers, opening hours, salaries and shopping.

projects.name: Pseudo Personalised Spam Classifier
projects.description: Small classifier separating genuine stranger email from AI-era pseudo-personalised mass outreach that evades spam filters. Public, pseudonymised dataset.

projects.name: RTL Skills
projects.description: Right-to-left skills for AI agents: Hebrew and RTL email, Typst PDFs, letters, HTML newsletters, Google Workspace and generated files

projects.name: Voice Note Task Classifier
projects.description: Small multi-label classifier that routes voice-note transcripts to task-specific subagents (email, calendar, to-do, spec...). Public successor of v0.1.0.

projects.name: Parakeet Dictation Cleanup Eval
projects.description: Status (2026-10-16): placeholder. No clips recorded yet.
